capabilityNotice: Choose an independent connection and model. Saving these settings does not submit a request or access your microphone, camera or files.
speechNotice: Choose a separate Flash or Pro binding, then generate one speaker on the Media page. The completed audio can be played and saved as WAV or MP3; this is not streaming playback. Saving settings does not generate audio.
title: AI services
intro: Save MOSS connections, then choose independent models for dictation, images, media understanding, speech, voice design, transcription and realtime audio or vision.
words: provider MOSS connection model key dictation image generation snapshot understanding speech audio AI
understandingNotice: Configure the independent connection and model. Select files and explicitly approve uploads on the Media page. Saving this configuration does not upload or run inference.
imageModelHint: Stable names follow provider updates; dated snapshots pin the model version. Account access and quality still require a real request to verify.
imageNotice: Save a default connection and model, then submit a task on the Images page. Saving settings does not generate an image.
reloadAsk: Discard unsaved changes and load the latest settings?
empty: No provider connections yet. Add a MOSS connection to configure default uses.
name: Connection name
removeAsk: Remove this connection from the draft? Saving applies the change and requires unbinding its uses first.
saveFirst: Save changes before querying the account's available models.
discoveryHint: Catalog only, no inference. A listed model has not been verified by inference.
noModels: This account returned an empty model catalog.
modelHint: Only integrated transcription models are offered. Account permission and quality still require a real request to verify.
liveHint: MOSS Live uses its own connection and model. Changing the dictation model does not change the realtime protocol.
bindingHint: Unbind uses before deleting, disabling or clearing a connection's key. In-flight requests keep their starting configuration; new requests use the updated settings.
